paper_title: First Scan Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter with a Tunable Superconducting Radio-Frequency Cavity
notes: Tunable niobium SRF cavity dark photon DM scan search. Scanned 1.37 MHz centered at 1.3 GHz (f_max=1.299164 GHz). Best limit epsilon<2.2e-16 at 90% CL. Mass converted from frequency via m=4.136e-15*f: ~5.37e-6 eV over the narrow scanned band. Only overall best value quoted in text (no per-bin table available), so the two points approximate the flat exclusion across the scan range. rho_A'=0.45 GeV/cm^3. | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.83, 2))
